greeting.text: Father says it was you. He says you went down into the tunnel for me with nothing but a stranger's name. I am not used to being rescued. I think I should like it, as long as it is by someone I like. Do you care for me?

effects.message: She takes a locket from her neck and presses it into your hand.

gift.text: Then take this. Open it and it will tell you how far you have come, and a little thread of light will always point you home. Come back to me, whatever else happens.

again.text: Then think about it. I will ask again.
